intent: Implement PipelineSubscriber (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Infrastructure subscription bean wiring the validated sample stream to ReorderHistoryService (source -> sink) as a Spring SmartLifecycle: start() subscribes sequentially, stop() disposes. This is the unit that places the History rule on the data path. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration. No logger.

methods.semantics: Subscribes stream.events() -> concatMap(service.handle) once; a per-event error is swallowed with onErrorResume to Mono.empty() so the subscription survives.
Signal consumed by the Spring lifecycle: true while the subscription is active and not disposed; false before start and after stop.
